buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

The citation frame shall be of premium quality, suitable for official presentation and ceremonial purposes. The frame shall be made of high-quality wood, MDF, metal or equivalent durable material. The frame shall have an elegant and attractive finish with a scratch-resistant surface. The front side shall be covered with clear, transparent glass or high-quality acrylic sheet. The frame shall include a suitable backing board for proper support and protection of the citation. The frame shall have a proper mounting arrangement for wall hanging. The frame should be provided with a suitable stand, if required. All edges and corners shall be properly finished without sharp edges or defects. The frame shall be free from scratches, cracks, dents, stains and manufacturing defects. The frame shall be supplied in the specified sizes of 12 × 14 inches and 14 × 18 inches. The supplier shall ensure proper finishing, colour consistency and overall appearance. Each frame shall be securely packed to prevent damage during transportation. The supplier shall replace any damaged or defective frame at no additional cost. The material and workmanship shall be of good quality and suitable for long-term use. The buyer reserves the right to reject items that do not conform to the approved specifications. Inspection & Acceptance: The supplied frames shall be inspected by the consignee. Payment shall be made only after satisfactory delivery and acceptance. The supplier shall ensure timely delivery as per the purchase order. Note: The dimensions mentioned above shall be in inches. .
